Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.CreditsText:
This mod started as a personal project to keep offline Tarkov (TKF) fun when many mods stopped being updated. Thanks to the Oddba community and the modders who freely shared tutorials, config parsing, and framework ideas, the first MG-Mod demo was born. Special thanks to: 物是人非's Super Module, techml's lazy mod, 夕阳与花's trader mod, Wind_L's server config guides, HsMikuKu's universal modding tutorials, iDkGK's mod tutorials, Silent.YH's guides and templates, Yuzuriha_Inori's mod tutorials, 千叶玲花's feature tutorials... and my good friends 大废物, AT, kmy, 星稀, sepi酱~, 臭学姐. The open-source community's kindness keeps me going. To those who stopped updating or left: we miss you, hope you're all doing well...
    (Full original Chinese essay applies; other languages get this brief summary.)

Raid.Desc.AiHealth: Adjusts the base health multiplier of all AI (Scavs, bosses, PMCs) in raid. Higher values make them harder to kill.
Raid.Desc.AiSpawnNumber: Adjusts the AI spawn limit in raid, controlling how many enemies appear on screen.
Raid.Desc.USECRatio: Adjusts the spawn ratio between USEC and Bear PMCs in raid.
Raid.Desc.AiNamePool: Enables an expanded name pool for AI; nicknames are no longer limited to the vanilla list.
Raid.Desc.PmcTacticalSquad: When enabled, a Hard-difficulty 3-man PMC tactical squad will additionally spawn at random locations on all maps with a certain probability.
Raid.Desc.PmcRoar: When enabled, killing PMCs has a chance to trigger out-of-raid private messages, adding extra PMC message content.
Raid.Desc.DefaultOptions: When enabled, you can customize the default pre-raid options: AI amount, difficulty, bosses, Scav wars, and marked-and-cursed.
Raid.Desc.AiAmount: Sets the AI amount tier (like online / none / low / medium / high / overwhelming horde). Requires “Default options” to be enabled.
Raid.Desc.AiDifficulty: Sets the AI difficulty tier (online / easy / medium / hard / hell / random).
Raid.Desc.EnableBoss: Whether to enable bosses and their guards in raid.
Raid.Desc.ScavCivilWar: When enabled, Scavs attack each other, causing factional civil war.
Raid.Desc.MarkedCursed: When enabled, some AI actively hunt the player, creating high-threat encounters.
Raid.Desc.RaidTime: Sets the maximum raid duration; the raid ends automatically when time expires.
Raid.Desc.BossSpawnRate: Adjusts boss spawn probability; higher values mean more frequent boss encounters.
Raid.Desc.AirdropType: Sets the airdrop content preference (weapons / supplies / medical / mixed, etc.).
Raid.Desc.AlwaysExtractSwitch: When enabled, all extract switches always work on the first pull.
Raid.Desc.AlwaysExtractable: When enabled, all extracts are always available.
Raid.Desc.UnlimitedExtractTime: Extracts are no longer limited by a countdown; you can extract at any time.
Raid.Desc.ScavNoCooldown: Removes the cooldown for entering raids as a Scav.
Raid.Desc.ScavGearBoost: Improves the quality of Scav starting gear and the value of carried loot.
Raid.Desc.NoLootLoss: On death, your backpack and equipment are no longer lost; all loot is kept.
Raid.Desc.MapRefreshConfig: When enabled, AI spawn configuration is optimized per map (BotSystem).
Raid.Desc.MapBotDifficulty: Sets the AI difficulty tier for all maps, overriding the global difficulty.
Raid.Desc.GlobalWeather: Selects the weather mode (vanilla / clear / rainy / storm / misty / extreme / custom).
Raid.Desc.Cloud: Adjusts cloud cover density; takes effect when global weather is not “vanilla”.
Raid.Desc.Wind: Adjusts wind strength, affecting ballistics and sound propagation.
Raid.Desc.GlobalLoot: Adjusts the global loot spawn multiplier across all maps.
Raid.Desc.ContainerLoot: Adjusts the loot spawn multiplier inside containers.
Raid.Desc.GroundLoot: Adjusts the loot spawn multiplier for loose ground loot.
Raid.Desc.ValuableLoot: Adjusts the spawn multiplier for valuable items (keys, intel, etc.).
Raid.Desc.DisableRandomContainers: When enabled, containers no longer spawn randomly on the map; their positions are fixed.
Raid.Desc.Map.Customs: When enabled, items lost on Customs can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Factory: When enabled, items lost on Factory can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Interchange: When enabled, items lost on Interchange can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Labs: When enabled, items lost in the Lab can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Lighthouse: When enabled, items lost on Lighthouse can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Reserve: When enabled, items lost on Reserve can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.GroundZero: When enabled, items lost on Ground Zero can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Shoreline: When enabled, items lost on Shoreline can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Streets: When enabled, items lost on Streets of Tarkov can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Woods: When enabled, items lost on Woods can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.Desc.Map.Labyrinth: When enabled, items lost on The Labyrinth can be returned by insurance after death or discard.
Raid.HeaderDesc.AI: AI settings: health, spawn numbers, faction ratios, name pool, and PMC behavior.
Raid.HeaderDesc.DefaultOptions: Customizes default raid options: AI amount, difficulty, bosses, and Scav behavior.
Raid.HeaderDesc.Raid: Raid duration, boss spawns, airdrops, extracts, and Scav settings.
Raid.HeaderDesc.Weather: Raid weather: global mode, clouds, wind, rain, and fog.
Raid.HeaderDesc.Resources: Global and per-map loot spawn multipliers.

Develop.Desc.UnloadSpeed: Adjusts the weapon reload speed multiplier (magazines and ammo).
Develop.Desc.SkillExpBoost: Boosts experience gain for all skills; leveling up becomes faster.
Develop.Desc.SupermanMode: Greatly boosts character abilities (stamina, carry weight, jump, speed, etc.) for a superhuman feel.
Develop.Desc.NoCarryLimit: Removes the carry weight limit and over-encumbrance penalties.
Develop.Desc.WeaponSlotCompat: Relaxes weapon attachment restrictions; any attachment fits any weapon.
Develop.Desc.WeaponNoJam: Disables weapon malfunction; firearms no longer jam randomly.
Develop.Desc.WeaponNoDurabilityLoss: Weapons no longer lose durability from use.
Develop.Desc.MagazineCapacity: Adjusts the capacity multiplier of all magazines.
Develop.Desc.HelmetHeadsetCompat: Allows helmets and headwear (headsets, etc.) to be worn together.
Develop.Desc.HelmetNoDebuff: Helmets no longer impose hearing, vision, or other debuffs.
Develop.Desc.HelmetNoWeight: Helmets no longer contribute to carry weight.
Develop.Desc.RigArmorCompat: Allows armor and rigs to be worn together without conflict.
Develop.Desc.RigArmorNoDebuff: Armor and rigs no longer impose movement or stamina debuffs.
Develop.Desc.RigArmorNoWeight: Armor and rigs no longer contribute to carry weight.
Develop.Desc.RigArmorNoDurabilityLoss: Armor and rigs no longer lose max durability when repaired.
Develop.Desc.PlateCarrierDurability: Adjusts the durability multiplier of armor plates and liners.
Develop.Desc.PlateCarrierNoDebuff: Plate carriers no longer impose movement penalties.
Develop.Desc.PlateCarrierNoWeight: Plate carriers no longer contribute to carry weight.
Develop.Desc.BackpackCompat: Allows backpacks to be nested inside each other (bag-in-bag).
Develop.Desc.BackpackCompact: Backpack internal volume is reduced — designed for the Thunder mega backpack.
Develop.Desc.BackpackNoDebuff: Backpacks no longer affect movement speed or other attributes.
Develop.Desc.BackpackNoWeight: Backpacks no longer count toward carry weight.
Develop.Desc.WeaponEnchant100: Repairing weapons with a repair kit has a 100% enchantment chance.
Develop.Desc.ArmorEnchant100: Repairing armor with a repair kit has a 100% enchantment chance.
Develop.Desc.InsuranceExpand: Expands the grid of secure containers.
Develop.Desc.InsuranceCompat: Secure containers can hold more categories of items.
Develop.Desc.InsuranceNoWeight: Items inside secure containers no longer count toward carry weight.
Develop.Desc.T7ThermalBoost: Enhances the display and detection performance of T-7 Thermal Goggles and similar thermal optics.
Develop.Desc.KeyUnlimitedDurability: Keys no longer lose durability from use.
Develop.Desc.MedicalItemDurability: Adjusts the durability or use count of medical items.
Develop.Desc.AmmoStack: Adjusts the stack size of ammunition.
Develop.Desc.MoneyStack: Adjusts the stack size of money.
Develop.Desc.FullInspect: All items can be fully inspected without identification (no more “unexamined” state).
Develop.Desc.QuestFreeReset: Quest resets no longer cost anything.
Develop.Desc.QuestOptimize: Simplifies quest conditions and lowers quest difficulty.
Develop.Desc.Quest3X4Marker: Marks the 3X4 quests, making it easier to tackle the 3X4 quest chain.
Develop.Desc.HideoutUpgradeTime: Adjusts the time required to upgrade hideout facilities.
Develop.Desc.HideoutProductionTime: Adjusts the time required for hideout production (crafting).
Develop.Desc.ScavCaseTime: Adjusts the cycle time of the Scav case (Lucky Scav Junk box).
Develop.Desc.HideoutUpgradeUnlimited: Hideout upgrades are no longer limited by level, materials, or prerequisite facilities.
Develop.Desc.HideoutAreaBonusLevel: Adjusts the skill bonus level granted by hideout facilities.
Develop.Desc.HideoutNoPower: Hideout areas no longer need power; fuel is no longer a requirement.
Develop.Desc.GymAlwaysSucceed: Gym workouts always succeed, greatly reducing the difficulty.
Develop.Desc.GymNoPenalty: Failed gym workouts no longer impose penalties.
Develop.Desc.GymRewardMultiplier: Adjusts the attribute reward multiplier from gym workouts.
Develop.HeaderDesc.BaseAttributes: Basic character stats: reload speed, skill experience, carry limits, etc.
Develop.HeaderDesc.WeaponOpt: Weapon settings: attachment compatibility, malfunctions, durability, and magazine capacity.
Develop.HeaderDesc.RigArmorOpt: Armor and rigs: compatibility, debuffs, weight, and durability.
Develop.HeaderDesc.PlateCarrierOpt: Armor plates and liners: durability, movement penalties, and weight.
Develop.HeaderDesc.BackpackOpt: Backpacks: nesting, size, debuffs, and weight.
Develop.HeaderDesc.EnchantOpt: Base stat enhancements for weapons and armor.
Develop.HeaderDesc.InsuranceOpt: Secure containers: expansion, item compatibility, and weight.
Develop.HeaderDesc.ItemAttrOpt: Item attributes: thermals, keys, and medical items.
Develop.HeaderDesc.WarehouseOpt: Ammo and money stack sizes, and full item inspection.
Develop.HeaderDesc.QuestSystem: Quest resets, simplified conditions, and the 3X4 quest chain.
Develop.HeaderDesc.Hideout: Hideout upgrades, production, power, and the gym.

Economy.Desc.FleaTradeMultiplier: Adjusts the Flea Market trade multiplier (listings/purchases).
Economy.Desc.FleaSell100: Items listed on the Flea Market always sell.
Economy.Desc.FleaInstantSell: Listings sell instantly without waiting for a buyer.
Economy.Desc.FleaBuyBoost: Optimizes the Flea Market buying experience (refresh and stock).
Economy.Desc.FleaBrandNew: Items sold on the Flea Market are always in brand-new condition.
Economy.Desc.FleaDisableBlacklist: Removes the Flea Market listing blacklist; all items can be listed.
Economy.Desc.FleaOpenLevel: Removes the level requirement for the Flea Market; available from the start.
Economy.Desc.LowTax: Greatly reduces the Flea Market transaction tax.
Economy.Desc.InsuranceReturnSpeed: Adjusts how long insurance returns take.
Economy.Desc.InsuranceReturnChance: Adjusts the insurance return success chance.
Economy.Desc.BuyWithHook: Allows buying items marked as found-in-raid (with the “hook”).
Economy.HeaderDesc.Flea: Flea Market trading, selling, buying, and tax settings.
Economy.HeaderDesc.Trader: Trader restock intervals and insurance settings.

Feature.Desc.IndependentTrader: Enables MG-Mod's independent traders (Muggle and FG), coexisting with official traders.
Feature.Desc.IndependentItem: Enables MG-Mod independent items (armor, rigs, keys, etc.).
Feature.Desc.IndependentPreset: Enables MG-Mod custom equipment presets. You can write gun presets to sell at the MG trader.
Feature.Desc.IndependentSave: Enables MG-Mod independent profile. Its content is not yet complete — currently it only differs from SPT Easy Start by adding gun presets for the Gunsmith 1–25 quests.
Feature.Desc.BulletData: Displays detailed bullet data in game (penetration, damage, etc.).
Feature.Desc.RealTimeFlea: Flea market data updates and refreshes in real time.
Feature.HeaderDesc.Independent: Toggles for MG-Mod independent traders, items, presets, and profiles.
Feature.HeaderDesc.Other: Bullet data, key organization, and real-time flea market.

Container.Desc.Enable: Enables grid expansion for this container, resizing it per the width/height settings below.
Container.Desc.Width: Sets the grid width of this container after expansion.
Container.Desc.Height: Sets the grid height of this container after expansion.
Container.Desc.Compatible: Allows this container to hold more categories of items.
Container.Desc.NoWeight: This container no longer counts toward carry weight.
